checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man
must.why: Same face, hair, shirt and kitchen across all frames.

must.item: Audible coherent agent-written English line inviting viewers to the sale
must.why: Script text is generic and inviting, and the audio has sound, but I can't hear it.

must.item: No invented discount, date, product or offer
must.why: The stated line mentions none of these.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth shapes vary across frames (open, rounded, closed), consistent with speaking. Exact sync can't be verified.

must.item: One square 8-second video, friendly male voice, no captions
must.why: Frames are square, no captions, 8 s. Voice friendliness can't be heard but Daniel was chosen.

faults.what: Eyes closed or squinting in some frames (3.2 s, 7.6 s), slightly unnatural expression
The 7.6 s frame shows him with eyes closed and mouth nearly shut, a slightly awkward ending

summary: The result is a square 8-second talking-head video that keeps the man's identity and background, with a visibly moving mouth and no captions. Only minor eye-closure quirks show, and the audio could not be heard.
